headline: Florida Southern win twice without conceding
dek: Four different players have scored Florida Southern's seven goals in wins over Barton and Middle Georgia State, and nobody has yet scored against them. Every other side in the conference has conceded.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Rollins alone have outscored Eckerd, Florida Tech, Barry, Nova Southeastern and Saint Leo put together.

wire.line: Rollins have conceded more goals than any other side in the conference and have still not lost.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: The record now carries one score gap: Nova Southeastern's home match against Florida Memorial has a final and no published score. Three more matches have passed their date with no result at all, and all three are Palm Beach Atlantic's, among them the match against Barry, a fellow member.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Palm Beach Atlantic have yet to lose and have won only once; the draws at home to Carson-Newman and away at Young Harris account for the rest.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Six different players have scored for Embry-Riddle in wins over Trinity of Jacksonville and Georgia Southwestern, the widest spread of scorers in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Kobi Thomas has scored three of Palm Beach Atlantic's five goals, from thirteen shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Henry Obi has made twelve saves in two defeats for Barry and conceded five.

last_match.line: Palm Beach Atlantic remain unbeaten, and have now drawn back-to-back matches.

next_match.line: Saint Leo play at home for the first time this season, still without a win; Viktor Danielsson has their only goal so far.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
